title: Exempt PR #9 squash f2a8453 from the history check
summary: Add the PR #9 squash commit f2a8453380196b95f2e2cc629ffa969af57e6c85 to `[history] exempt` in athena.toml, as D67 did for ee4b0dd. Add a comment, a new decision D70 and a CHANGELOG line. All three give the user's reason: most of PR #9's jobs predate athena.candidate/2, so the chain rule cannot link them. OP-11 is not cited anywhere.

One focused change: a single exempt entry plus its comment, decision and changelog line.
The change contains only the commit id and the reason, and no OP-11 reference, as the user asked.
The existing history check and the D60/D61 exempt validation enforce the entry.

assumptions: The new decision is D70, since D69 is the last entry in docs/decisions.md.
The user's stated reason replaces any other reason; D69's chain rule requires athena.candidate/2 records, which PR #9's older jobs lack.
The full id supplied is correct and in history; it cannot be checked from this snapshot.
The change follows the ee4b0dd precedent in D67 and D68: config, a decision and a changelog line, with no code.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml `[history] exempt` contains the full id f2a8453380196b95f2e2cc629ffa969af57e6c85 and keeps the three existing entries unchanged.

The comment above `exempt` in athena.toml says f2a8453 is the squash of PR #9 and gives the reason: most of PR #9's jobs predate athena.candidate/2, so the chain rule (D69) cannot link them. It does not mention OP-11.

docs/decisions.md gains D70 after D69 with decision, alternatives, tradeoff, reversal (delete the entry and comment) and provenance (user request). It cites D60, D67, D68 and D69. It does not mention OP-11.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry saying the history check no longer judges f2a8453, with the same reason. It does not mention OP-11.
The string OP-11 appears in no changed file.
Run `cargo test`: all tests pass, including any that parse athena.toml and validate the exempt list.
Run `git diff --stat` or `git status`: only athena.toml, docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md changed.

departures: Slightly higher acceptance than the reference, because the precedent is exact and the user has settled the reason. Cost and time are close to the reference.
